<div style="text-align: center; margin-top: 20px;">
  <object data="flowchart.svg" type="image/svg+xml" 
          style="width: 100%; max-width: 1100px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">
    <img src="flowchart.svg" alt="Biostatistics Model Selection Flowchart" style="width: 100%; max-width: 1100px;" />
  </object>
</div>

<div style="margin-top: 30px; padding: 20px; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #1a5276;">
  <h3 style="margin-top: 0; color: #1a5276;">How to use this flowchart</h3>
  <ol style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8;">
    <li><strong>Start at the top</strong> — identify what <em>type</em> of outcome variable you have.</li>
    <li><strong>Follow the arrows</strong> — each decision node asks a yes/no or multiple-choice question about your data.</li>
    <li><strong>Check assumptions</strong> — the yellow nodes remind you to verify normality, equal variance, etc.</li>
    <li><strong>Pick the model</strong> — dark blue nodes show the recommended statistical test or model.</li>
    <li><strong>When in doubt, go non-parametric</strong> — Wilcoxon, Mann-Whitney, Kruskal-Wallis, and Spearman are safer with small or non-normal samples.</li>
  </ol>
</div>

<div style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: #eaf2f8; border-radius: 8px;">
